topics.definition: Generative AI creates new content such as text, images, audio and code by learning patterns from data.
topics.example: Generate an article from a prompt
tips: Generative AI creates original outputs based on learned patterns.

topics.definition: LLMs are AI models trained on large text datasets to understand and generate human language.
tips: Transformers are the foundation of modern LLMs.

topics.definition: These models generate images from text or other inputs.
AI models can generate speech, sound effects and music.
AI models can create or edit videos using prompts or images.
Prompt engineering is the practice of writing effective prompts to obtain better AI outputs.
AI hallucinations occur when a model generates incorrect or fabricated information.
tips: Verify important information with reliable sources.

topics.definition: Generative AI is used for content creation, coding, education, design and customer support.
Use clear prompts, review outputs and respect privacy and copyright.
